name: Sommersville Shopping Center
summary: Sommersville Shopping Center is a community-focused retail destination in Antioch, California, serving the daily shopping needs of local residents. With convenient hours and a practical tenant mix, this neighborhood center provides accessible retail options for families in eastern Contra Costa County.
demographics: Sommersville Shopping Center serves the diverse Antioch community in eastern Contra Costa County, attracting primarily middle-income families and working professionals with household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $90,000. The trade area draws heavily from young families with children and multi-generational households typical of this growing suburban region. Shoppers tend to focus on convenience-oriented retail and everyday necessities, with strong preference for value-driven national chains and grocery-anchored shopping trips that serve the practical needs of the surrounding residential neighborhoods.
description: Sommersville Shopping Center, also known as Sommersville Towne Center, serves as a convenient neighborhood shopping destination in Antioch, California, located at 2500 Sycamore Drive. This community-oriented retail center caters to the daily needs of residents in eastern Contra Costa County, offering a practical mix of stores and services for families and working professionals in the area. The center operates with consistent hours from 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM, providing accessible shopping options for the local community. With a solid 3.8-star rating from over 110 reviews, Sommersville Shopping Center has established itself as a reliable retail hub in the rapidly growing Antioch market. The center's strategic location and tenant mix reflect the evolving needs of this diverse suburban community, making it a practical choice for everyday shopping and errands.
